operation_details.item: The user completed the internal audit walkthrough of accounts payable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, finally finished that AP walkthrough this morning. Feels good to have that off my plate.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice! That was the one with the vendor invoice samples, right? How did it go?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, exactly. It went smoother than I expected, honestly. Only a couple of minor gaps in documentation, nothing major.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good to hear. So the control matrix is pretty much done then? I remember you were updating that alongside the walkthrough.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yep, control matrix is prepared. I just need to review it one more time before the external auditor meeting, but it's in good shape.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's great. And management is already looking at the findings? Or are they still reviewing?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: They're responding now. I sent them the draft findings, and they're putting together their action items. Should be ready before the meeting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect, so we're on track. The external auditor meeting is still scheduled for Thursday, right?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, Thursday at 10. I'll have everything bundled together by then, so we can just walk through it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a solid plan. Let me know if you need any help pulling numbers or formatting anything before then.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I completed the accounts payable walkthrough; keep the control matrix, management response, and auditor meeting.
